events.title: Tips for Beginners
events.summary: Welcome to Stars of Icarus! No matter if you’ve played Guns of Icarus, you’re a space dogfighting ace, or this is your first time behind the helm, here’s a couple tips for your first time out!1) Try out all the gunsEvery gun is different. What each gun is good at is determined by a couple key factors. The most important things to look at are their damage types.
